misses.what: removeUserOldImageFromCDN is a server action with no login or ownership check and now deletes whatever UploadThing URL the caller passes (settings/actions.ts) instead of the picture stored in the database, so anyone can delete arbitrary files from the app's file storage.
The actual fix: users without a profile picture (e.g. email-OTP sign-ups) can now upload an avatar and save settings; previously saving failed with 'Something went wrong'.
updateUser(id, payload) in the same settings actions file is still an unauthenticated server action that updates any user's name/email/picture by id (pre-existing, not introduced here).
